description: This script is a utility for fixing translation inconsistencies in documentation markdown files, particularly comparing translated versions to English originals and applying corrections automatically.

classes.name: typer.Typer
classes.description: Main CLI application class from the Typer library used to create command-line interfaces.

methods.name: Iterable[Path] iter_all_lang_paths(lang_path_root: Path)
methods.description: Yields markdown file paths for a given language directory, prioritizing certain subdirectories.

methods.name: get_all_paths(lang: str)
methods.description: Returns a list of relative paths to markdown files in a specific language, excluding non-translated sections.

methods.name: bool process_one_page(path: Path)
methods.description: Fixes a single documentation page by comparing it to its English version and optionally auto-correcting translation issues.

methods.name: fix_all(ctx: typer.Context, language: str)
methods.description: CLI command to process all documentation pages for a specified language.

methods.name: fix_pages( doc_paths: Annotated[ list[Path], typer.Argument(help="List of paths to documents."), ], )
methods.description: CLI command to process specific documentation pages provided as arguments.

ctags.name: fix_pages
ctags.signature: ( doc_paths: Annotated[ list[Path], typer.Argument(help="List of paths to documents."), ], )
